scope: Whole-value POSITION/XYZWPR assignment conversion using explicit checked geometry

reference_basis.documented: Positional types can be assigned across representations; POSITION contains read-only NORMAL/ORIENT/APPROACH vectors and writable LOCATION/CONFIG data
reference_basis.uncertainty: Native conversion arithmetic, matrix tolerances, Euler conventions and other positional/group/kinematic mappings remain unverified

implementation_choices.assignment: Only exact POSITION/XYZWPR whole-value pairs, including aliases, fields/elements and explicitly typed RHS results; parameters, RETURN and whole arrays keep exact type requirements
implementation_choices.mapping: NORMAL/ORIENT/APPROACH are X/Y/Z rotation columns under the portable Rz(r) Ry(p) Rx(w) convention; LOCATION is XYZ; copy CONFIG independently
implementation_choices.matrix: Complete finite POSITION; column norms within 1e-9 of one, pairwise dot products within 1e-9 of zero and determinant within 1e-9 of +1; no inferred columns or matrix repair
implementation_choices.angles: Reverse conversion uses frame_transform_semantics.json canonical/gimbal Euler policy; finite locations without POS constructor coordinate bounds
implementation_choices.protection: POSITION orientation starts unknown; explicit conversion initializes it while retaining recursive read-only fields; detached VECTOR copies remain writable
implementation_choices.effects: Evaluate and convert once before target expressions; preserve source effects and destination on conversion failure; stable existing destination storage and ordinary FOR/frame cleanup
implementation_choices.reports: Source-located position_conversions with source/target type and target kind, plus current position_conversion_policy; exact copies are not conversion sites

retained_boundaries: No other positional/ARRAY/interface coercion, cast-call syntax or automatic FRAME/INV/UNPOS/colon operand conversion
No direct POSITION orientation writes, orientation defaults, controller context, external axes, native kinematics or configuration inference
Strict remains future work; independent quaternion and fixture checks establish offline geometry only
